page.overview:
Who is Iris Carroll?

Iris Carroll is an English former housekeeper of the Lockwood Manor, the former nanny of Maisie Lockwood and the keeper of all the family's secrets. She was a longtime employee of Sir Benjamin Lockwood and served that role right until his death.

Iris served as the housekeeper for the Lockwood Family for many years. The exact date of when she was hired is not known but she has worked for Sir Benjamin long enough to raise both his daughter and "granddaughter" from their respective births.

Lockwood's daughter, Charlotte, was raised by Iris at Lockwood Manor. At one point, the two took a photo together which became a memento of Sir Benjamin. Iris was successful in raising Charlotte from childhood to adulthood and saw her marry an unnamed man for a husband. However, Iris thought tragedy struck when in the mid 1990s, Charlotte and her husband were killed in a "car accident." The event devastated Sir Benjamin who (supposedly) in his grief, began to try and bring his daughter "back" through cloning. Iris helped keep Sir Benjamin's secrets over the matter and years later in 2009, Lockwood's "granddaughter" Maisie Lockwood was born.

Iris helped Sir Benjamin in raising his "grandchild" as she knew the original best, understood her interests and sense of humor. Iris also subtlety helped the new child be closer to her original through teaching her a "Queen's English" accent. Another reason for her aid in helping raising Maisie was Sir Benjamin's declining health in his older age which left him unable to walk.
